test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: 90 people are standing in a row facing north. Mr. Leu is 16th from the right end, while Mr. Sanga is 39th from the left end. How many people are there between Mr. Leu and Mr. Sanga?
solution:
The total number of people is 90, and Mr. Leu is 16th from the right end. The formula to find the position from the opposite end is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7345452d48fb3d9817d4d6157bff6cfe26c99181934389e9e95a56480a189f8e.png] Position from left = Total people − Position from right + 1

Plugging in the values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7345452d48fb3d9817d4d6157bff6cfe26c99181934389e9e95a56480a189f8e.png] Mr. Leu′s position from left = 90 – 16 + 1 = 74 + 1 = 75

So, Mr. Leu is in the 75th position from the left end. 

Now we have the positions of both individuals from the same end (the left end): 

 
• Mr. Sanga's position from the left = 39
 
• Mr. Leu's position from the left = 75 

The number of people between two positions is the difference in their positions minus one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7345452d48fb3d9817d4d6157bff6cfe26c99181934389e9e95a56480a189f8e.png] People between=Mr. Leu′s position−Mr. Sanga′s position−1

Plugging in the values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7345452d48fb3d9817d4d6157bff6cfe26c99181934389e9e95a56480a189f8e.png] People between=75−39−1=36−1=35

There are 35 people standing between Mr. Leu and Mr. Sanga

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
